title: Scoped paths, payload sizes and literal launches are enforced at the boundary; observers mutate nothing; diagnostics and audit records carry no secret

cases.summary: The owner launches a literal argv full of shell metacharacters with a secret in its environment; the launcher receives the exact vector, the authorized history read lists the claude store, returning a session named like a shell command and a prompt injection as inert data, and the audit trail keeps the sequence, machine, runtime, operation id, principal, argv and outcome with the secret redacted (secret_hits 0).

Store traversal and a symlink escape are forbidden, an oversized store reference and an oversized argv element are too_large with their bound, and a launch that sets the runtime's process token is forbidden without echoing it. Then the observer sends all 51 published mutations other than the observing attach.open (input, prompt, resize, takeover, launch, document, layout, plugin, machine, update and credential calls) and an upstream stream DATA frame: every call is forbidden before its handler, the DATA frame closes its connection as an unowned channel, the PTY byte count stays 0, the machine registry is unchanged, no effect file appears and the audit trail holds no secret (secret_hits 0).

data.hint: drop OVIS_TERMINAL_ variables; the runtime sets its own bindings
